name: @studio-dao/aether-browser-mcp
description: Aether Browser MCP: Ultra token-efficient Chrome extension and native bridge for AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Antigravity)

scripts.build:chrome: node -e "process.env.TARGET_BROWSER='chrome'; import('child_process').then(cp => cp.execSync('npx vite build', { stdio: 'inherit' }))"
scripts.build:firefox: node -e "process.env.TARGET_BROWSER='firefox'; import('child_process').then(cp => cp.execSync('npx vite build', { stdio: 'inherit' }))"

author: Studio Dao
